FerryWellCo is an Amsterdam team working on environmental context for outdoor activity platforms. GOTime is a planning layer designed for outdoor activity apps. It helps people compare heat and air-quality conditions for a planned run, walk, ride or group session. The current example uses heat and PM2.5. Start at the [homepage](https://ferrywellco.com/) or [GOTime for outdoor platforms](https://ferrywellco.com/applications/).

See [For platforms](https://ferrywellco.com/applications/) for potential placements in outdoor apps and a focused pilot approach. The [science page](https://ferrywellco.com/science/) covers air pollution, heat and pollen. The [privacy page](https://ferrywellco.com/privacy/) describes the email contact form.
